description: This header file defines the WebPA abstraction APIs related to libparodus client management, notification configuration, and message sending within a specific software project.

methods.name: libpd_set_notifyConfigFile
methods.description: Sets the notification configuration file used by libparodus.

methods.name: libpd_client_mgr
methods.description: Initializes the libparodus client and loads the database, managing the connection.

methods.name: stop_parodus_recv_wait
methods.description: Stops the thread waiting for incoming parodus messages.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification message with specified payload, source, and destination.
